{{Infobox auto}}
'''Shepherd's shears''' are shears with Looting III, sold by the [[Shepherd|shepherd]]. With {{Value|Shepherd's Shears|durability}} durability they last as long as [[Shears|steel shears]], and they are repaired with blocks of copper.

== Obtaining ==
=== Trading ===
A level 2 shepherd sells them for 3 [[Obol|obols]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/shepherd/2/shepherds_shears.json}}</ref>

{{Sources}}

== Usage ==
They have {{Value|Shepherd's Shears|durability}} durability and are repaired in an [[anvil]] with blocks of copper, as their tooltip says.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/shepherd/2/shepherds_shears.json}}</ref> Looting works on shears in Matcha Flavoured: each Looting level adds up to 3 extra wool per stack when shearing sheep. See [[Shears]].
